verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Semgrep documents an official MCP server at docs.semgrep.dev/mcp, which covers the core of the story: connecting an agent to Semgrep through a first-party MCP server. The evidence is only that probe confirmation; the pack has no detail on what the server does or how to set it up. missing for 10: documented tool/capability list, setup and authentication details, supported agent clients, independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.
